summary: Today adds eight new items led by offline benefits systems in Britain, a confirmed password manager compromise and an intrusion into a U.S. Air Force cloud platform, plus a news agency outage, live AI hacking campaigns, a pre-auth Linux kernel flaw, a medical breach notice and signed installer abuse, with two updates on Drupal and supply chain installers and a revisit on exploited geospatial flaws added to the federal catalog.
